items.title: PRESS RELEASE
items.summary: An Indian Parliamentary Delegation led by Shri Harivansh, Hon’ble Deputy Chairman, Rajya Sabha, is presently participating in the 153rd IPU Assembly in Arusha, Tanzania. On 05 October 2026, the first day of the Assembly, Members of the Delegation participated in various meetings and engagements.
key_facts: Hon’ble Deputy Chairman, Rajya Sabha and Members of the Delegation also participated in the meetings of the Asia-Pacific Geopolitical Group.

During the meeting, Smt. Aparajita Saranagi, MP, Lok Sabha and member of the IPU Executive Committee, briefed the group members about the recent activities and initiatives undertaken by the IPU Executive Committee.
Smt. Bijuli Kalita Medhi, MP, Lok Sabha, participated in the second session of the Forum on the theme “Women Leadership”.

items.title: Raksha Mantri launches first indigenous Fleet Support Ship ‘INS Surya’ at Hindustan Shipyard Ltd in Visakhapatnam
items.summary: Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh launched the first Fleet Support Ship (FSS-1), laid the keel of the fifth Fleet Support Ship (FSS-5) and inaugurated the upgraded Slipway-4 and 300-tonne Goliath Crane at Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL), Visakhapatnam on October 06, 2026.
key_facts: RM highlighted HSL’s attainment of Miniratna Category-I status in 2025 after it came under the Ministry of Defence as an important milestone reflecting its transformation and sustained efforts.
He noted that a Navy operating for extended periods in distant maritime areas requires not only warships but also logistics, maintenance, sustained support and operational endurance.
FSS-1, named ‘Surya’, was launched following the traditional honours performed by Smt. Laila Swaminathan, President, Navy Wives Wellness Association (NWWA).

items.title: Department of Justice Successfully Concludes Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026.
items.summary: To strengthen voluntarism and collective action for Swachhata, a campaign on Swachhata Hi Seva-2026 was organized by the Department of Justice during 17th September to 2nd October, 2026 under the theme of this year ''Swachhata Mein Sahbhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat”.

Hon’ble Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Law and Justice led the Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026 in the Department of Justice on 1st October, 2026.

items.title: E-Sanjeevani Crosses 50 Crore Teleconsultations, Strengthening Access to Healthcare Across the Country
items.summary: In a landmark achievement, India’s National Telemedicine Service, eSanjeevani, has crossed 50 crore (500 million) teleconsultations, marking a significant milestone in the Government’s efforts to leverage digital technology to make quality healthcare more accessible, affordable and equitable for citizens across the…
items.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
key_facts: The platform crossed the landmark on September 15, 2026, recording a cumulative 50,00,92,730 teleconsultations across all 36 States and Union Territories.
Available in 15 languages, including English and 14 Indian languages, the platform is facilitating approximately 2.5–3 lakh consultations every day.

Women account for 57.14 per cent of total utilisation, while 40.15 per cent of consultations are availed by citizens aged 46 years and above, including 16.25 per cent by senior citizens aged 60 years and above.

items.title: Ministry of Rural Development Notifies 375 Permissible Works under VB–G RAM G
items.summary: The Ministry of Rural Development has notified the Schedule of Permissible Works under the Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) [VB–G RAM G] Act, 2025, providing for 375 permissible works under the new rural works framework.
key_facts: The works have been reorganised around four thematic pillars — Water Security, Core Rural Infrastructure, Livelihood-related Infrastructure and Special Works for Extreme Weather Events and Disaster Preparedness.
The share of livelihood-related works rises substantially, accounting for 26 per cent of the total permissible works under the new framework, compared with 1.1 per cent under the previous framework.
Focus on Farmers, Vulnerable Households, Women and Rural Youth The Schedule places particular emphasis on agriculture, vulnerable households, women and rural youth.

items.title: DRI cracks down on cross-border gold smuggling along Indo-Bangladesh border; seizes over 8.3 kg foreign-origin gold; 4 arrested
items.summary: Continuing its sustained crackdown on organised gold smuggling, the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) has seized around 8.3 kg foreign-origin gold valued at approximately Rs. 12.37 crore in intelligence-led operation in an operation along the Indo-Bangladesh border.
key_facts: Four persons have been arrested in connection with the smuggling activities.
A personal search of the suspects led to the recovery of gold biscuits, which were concealed in specially tailored cloth waist belts worn by two of them.
A total of 72 gold biscuits, each weighing 116 grams, were recovered from the possession of the said four persons.

items.title: Secretary (Labour & Employment) Leads ‘Shram Samvad’ at Rudrapur, Uttarakhand
items.summary: The Ministry of Labour & Employment, in collaboration with the Labour Department, Government of Uttarakhand, and in association with the Kumaun Garhwal Chamber of Commerce, Entrepreneur Welfare Committee (SEWS-SIDCUL), and SIDCUL Industrial Welfare Association (SSIWA), organized a 'Shram Samvad' - District-Level…
key_facts: The programme brought together employers and industry stakeholders to strengthen awareness and understanding of the Labour Codes, which came into force on 21 November 2025, and the Central Rules notified on 8 May 2026.

Four technical sessions were held, focusing on a comprehensive overview of the Labour Codes, key compliance requirements for employers under the Codes, and on various facets of PMVBRY and PMSYM, respectively.
The programme provided a valuable platform for addressing practical implementation challenges and fostering a deeper understanding of the new regulatory framework.

items.title: IndiaAI Mission Organised AIKosh University Engagement Programme at National Institute of Technology, Andhra Pradesh to Strengthen India's AI Talent Ecosystem

key_facts: Through the AIKosh University Engagement Programme, the IndiaAI Mission seeks to introduce students and academic institutions to these national AI assets while encouraging hands-on learning and innovation.

items.title: Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority (ITLA)
items.summary: India's Expanding Transport and Logistics Network As India’s economy grows, so does the need to move goods efficiently across the country. Meeting this requirement calls for transport networks that are well connected and planned as an integrated system.
key_facts: To support these growing requirements, the Government on 6 October 2026 approved the setting up of the Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority (ITLA).

items.title: Small and Medium Enterprises Growth Fund
items.summary: Enterprises are classified as micro, small or medium based on investment in plant and machinery or equipment, and annual turnover. Under the latest criteria (effective from April 2025), a small enterprise has investment of up to ₹25 crore and turnover of up to ₹100 crore.
key_facts: A medium enterprise has investment of up to ₹125 crore and turnover of up to ₹500 crore.
To support their growth, the Union Cabinet has approved a commitment of ₹10,000 crore towards establishing the SME Growth Fund (SGF).
It aims to support the emergence of champion enterprises across manufacturing, services, technology, innovation-driven sectors and strategic value chains.
